stages.name: refine
evidence: Reviewed #229, the MCP Product Change, the #226 architecture assessment, current identity/authorization architecture, and the merged #227/#228 delivery boundary.
Confirmed that the existing local JWT module is not an OAuth/OIDC provider and that application handlers remain the household authorization boundary.
Recorded explicit scope exclusions: no write tools, no token passthrough, no provider selection by assumption, and no production credentials during this planning stage.

stages.name: propose
evidence: Draft PR #270 opened for the documentation-only proposal.

Independent proposal review at exact head c151e6a5ec1224e1c6019925e3b31d69d1ac44e0 requested four corrections: decide provider/placement, define household-bound consent and revocation contracts, require canonical resource binding, and specify CIMD SSRF/DNS-rebinding defenses.

Correction round 1 selected in-process OpenIddict in DomusMind.Api, defined a single household-bound grant tuple with immediate next-request revocation checks, made resource mandatory end-to-end, and added metadata-fetch security controls and tests.
Independent proposal review round 2 approved exact corrected plan head 000ae3971a9e45c0204ef359631fb0e45689884d; implementation may begin.

stages.name: implement
evidence: Added OpenIddict 7.7.2 authorization-server and EF Core token/authorization persistence in DomusMind.Api's existing host; added migration and proposed ADR-0012.

Added protected-resource metadata, OIDC discovery, exact MCP resource registration, Authorization Code + PKCE configuration, short-lived access tokens, refresh-token configuration, and revocation-capable token validation.

Mapped the interactive authorization boundary to existing AuthUser records and FamilyAuthorizationService checks; household context is carried in the token and local API JWTs remain a separate scheme.
Added an explicit antiforgery-protected OAuth consent form; only an explicit allow submission can issue an authorization code.

Added a token endpoint for authorization-code and refresh-token grants with exact resource checks, local OpenIddict validation, audience enforcement, current user/household checks, and consent/token revocation.

Added MCP bearer enforcement with safe 401 challenges, exact audience checks, current AuthUser and household access checks, structured post-execution security audit events, configurable rate limiting, and no production tools or writes; no token passthrough or persistence access from MCP middleware.

Closed the independent audit findings with production antiforgery registration, grant-specific consent withdrawal, rolling refresh-token reuse protection, isolated test databases, and a real Streamable HTTP MCP client test.
Enabled authorization-entry validation so revoking a grant denies tokens created concurrently with withdrawal; isolated refresh-token reuse evidence from current account/membership scenarios.

Focused OAuth contract tests pass: 15 passed, including login, explicit consent, PKCE exchange, refresh rotation/reuse, actual MCP transport, resource/audience, expiry, insufficient scope, current account/membership denial, authorization replay, rate limiting, and revocation. Full Release suite passes: 879 passed, 3 skipped. Build passes with 0 errors; inherited Kiota and MessagePack advisories remain documented exceptions.
Sanitized the structured audit operation to the fixed value MCP /mcp so request-controlled method/path values cannot reach logs and CodeQL log-forging findings are eliminated.

Final-head GitHub backend CI run 39461961513 passed build, 882 tests with zero skips, and publish; final-head CodeQL run 39461966335 passed C# and JavaScript analysis, and the repository has no open code-scanning alerts.

findings: Provider/placement was unresolved despite #226 assigning the decision to #229 planning.
Household-bound consent, multi-household switching, token lifetimes and revocation timing were not testable enough.
The plan allowed an equivalent audience contract instead of requiring the canonical MCP resource parameter and token binding.
CIMD metadata-fetch SSRF, redirects and DNS rebinding lacked explicit controls and negative tests.
reviews.evidence: Independent read-only proposal review; no files or GitHub state changed.
Independent read-only proposal review confirmed all four correction findings closed; no runtime tests were run.

findings: CodeQL reported four open cs/log-forging findings for request-controlled method/path values in MCP security audit logs; the FF metadata incorrectly claimed no findings.
reviews.evidence: Independent final-head Done audit; backend CI passed 882 tests with zero skips, but CodeQL findings required correction.

changes: Selected in-process OpenIddict server/validation in DomusMind.Api, with AuthUser mapping and infrastructure token/consent records; documented rejected alternatives and ADR requirement.

Bound grants/tokens to AuthUser, client, resource, household and scopes; defined multi-household re-consent and five-minute access/rotating thirty-day refresh policy with immediate next-request token-entry validation and live authorization checks.
Required the exact canonical MCP resource in authorization and token requests and rejected missing/alternate/mismatched values.
Added pre-registration-first policy and CIMD HTTPS, bounded, no-redirect, no-private-address, DNS-rebinding and timeout/size controls with negative tests.
corrections.validation: git diff --check and Markdown lint passed. Independent proposal review round 2 approved the corrected plan.

changes: Registered antiforgery in production composition and added production-safe certificate/disabled-mode coverage.
Changed consent withdrawal to validate one OpenIddict AdHoc authorization against the configured client and subject, then revoke only its tokens.
Added a structured redacted MCP security audit event around authorization denial and completed/failed transport execution, plus a bounded fixed-window rate limiter.

Separated authorization-code replay from refresh-token reuse evidence, enabled zero-leeway rolling refresh tokens, exercised the official Streamable HTTP MCP client, and added negative OAuth boundary tests.
corrections.validation: Focused OAuth suite 15/15; full Release suite 879 passed, 3 skipped; Release build 0 errors; backend CI and CodeQL passed on ae4fa48. Final independent Done audit found four CodeQL log-forging alerts, corrected in round 3.

changes: Replaced request-controlled method/path interpolation in MCP security audit events with the fixed semantic operation identifier MCP /mcp, including rate-limit audit events.
Re-ran the focused OAuth suite, full Release suite, Release build, backend CI, and CodeQL; no open code-scanning alerts remain.
corrections.validation: Focused OAuth suite 15/15; full Release suite 879 passed, 3 skipped; Release build 0 errors; backend CI run 39461961513 passed 882 tests with zero skips and publish; CodeQL run 39461966335 passed both analyses with no open alerts. Final independent Done audit pending.
